Solo AoD - Ranged

​
Introduction
This is an advanced guide to hybrid solo AOD  It is assumed you are familiar with the mechanics of the boss as well as having a strong sense of timing for prayer flicking. This guide covers strategies to maximize efficiency in this encounter. For a single kill for the CA, #unknown-channel is recommended instead due to ease of access and gentler learning curve.
​

Mechanics in phase 3 will happen in a semi-random order, with the primary restrictions being that ice cannot happen first and the same mechanic cannot happen back-to-back:

⬥ Ice: You go into a 'stasis' mode where bled channels will get cancelled and you are no longer able to attack the boss

​

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DPS gear and boosts from bonfire / desert pantheon aura  + thermal spa  will put you >12.8k maximum health 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fortitude  may be flicked on for up to 1000 additional maximum health 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Save  for second pools so that you enter pillar phase with high hp
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be wary of an invisible autoattack as Nex finishes her initial animation of spawning the pool

Phase 4
⬥ All mechanics are straightforward from here on. Cycle between  and  to quickly finish the encounter.
⬥ Bombs can be placed at max range on a wall next to a pillar or as close to the pillar as possible to leave as much open space as possible
⬥  /  can be used to deal with the constant autoattacks from Nex
⬥ After all pillars have been defeated, you can reposition middle, only surging out to place bombs
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure to keep track of which bar is the instakill / bomb if doing this to prevent accidentally bombing mid
